name: ecd-spectra
description: Precise extraction of experimental ECD spectra, measurement conditions, and stereochemical evidence from scientific literature.

interface.shortDescription: Recover ECD spectra, conditions, and stereochemical evidence.
interface.longDescription: An auditable visual workflow for extracting ECD curves, showing progress and overlays, capturing experimental conditions and stereochemical evidence, and generating self-contained HTML and Markdown reports before comparison with computed spectra.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $extract-ecd-spectra to extract this published ECD spectrum into a validated numerical package.
